english.title: Breach of Binding over to keep the peace / be of good behaviour - Magistrates Court Act 1980
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having entered into a recognizance to keep the peace or be of good behaviour by **(..SPECIFY THE COURT..) on **(..SPECIFY THE DATE OF ISSUE OF THE BINDING OVER ORDER..) breached that order in that **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE BREACH..)

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: With regard to the time limit for prosecution of six months - section 1.387 of Stones Justices manual says that where an offence consists of a course of conduct, and the last incident relied on to complete it occurred within six months of the laying of the information then section 127 is not violated. DPP v Baker (2004).
